transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Severus! My crystallized pineapple is ruined — that jar was a gift from the Minister himself! And you've used my personal cauldron without asking! I have the Potions Guild inspection in two hours and the storeroom looks like a hippogriff went through it. You promised to keep it tidy!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I am aware of the state of the storeroom, Slughorn. It is regrettable, but I have been preoccupied with preparing for the upcoming term. As for your cauldron, I required it for a urgent matter regarding the future of the school. I assure you, no harm has come to it.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Preoccupied? Severus, I specifically asked you to ensure things were in order! And "urgent matter regarding the future of the school"? It's heirloom quality, not some common school property for you to just commandeer! And look at this mess! Scales everywhere, half-eaten Fizzing Whizbees… it's an absolute disaster! How am I supposed to present this to the Guild? They'll think I'm running a pigsty!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Slughorn, I understand the gravity of the situation. However, as Potions Master, I have an obligation to the school that transcends your personal concerns. You think a few flicks of your wand will clear away this level of… *chaos*? My reputation is hanging by a thread, and you're treating it like a trivial inconvenience! I told you, this pineapple was a gift from the Minister! The *Minister*! Do you have any idea how much political capital that cost me?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Slughorn, I appreciate the value you place on your gifts and reputation. However, as I've already stated, I will ensure the storeroom is in presentable condition for the inspection. Regarding your pineapple, I can provide you with a suitable replacement. As for your cauldron, I can perform a thorough cleaning to restore its condition. transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: "Minor setbacks"? Severus, you stand there amidst a catastrophe of your making and call it "minor"? transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Slughorn, it is clear that we have differing perspectives on the severity of the situation. However, I reiterate my commitment to resolving these issues. As for the replacement of your pineapple, I shall approach the proper channels to secure an appropriate substitute. transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Slughorn, I acknowledge that I have not met your expectations in this matter. However, it is not within my nature to apologize unnecessarily. I will address each of your concerns in turn: the storeroom will be organized, your cauldron will be restored, and a replacement for your pineapple will be secured. I suggest we focus on the tasks at hand rather than dwell on what has been said. It is in the best interest of both our careers to ensure that the Potions Department is presented in the best possible light.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:

transcript.speaker: roleplayer

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:

transcript.speaker: antagonist

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: As you prefer, then. Observe, Slughorn. The room will be restored to order, and your cauldron will be returned to its pristine state. transcript.speaker: antagonist
